title: Grateful Dead Live at Veterans Auditorium on 1969-06-27

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard capture of an early, trippy Dead show with standout Casey Jones, Dire Wolf and a flowing Dark Star.
ai_review.review: The recording, sourced from the soundboard, is generally clear though a few minor anomalies are noted. Musically the performance shines as an embryonic version of classic material – a long‑lead‑in, slower Casey Jones, a steel‑pedal‑rich Dire Wolf with Bobby on vocals, and a surprisingly organic Dark Star that hints at later 1972 jams. The set feels experimental and energetic, offering fans a rare glimpse of the band’s developmental stage.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance with several standout tracks; recording is solid soundboard quality with only minor sound glitches, leading to an overall high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and well‑balanced, but reviewers mention occasional minor sound problems or anomalies.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early versions are worked out on stage, giving the set a quirky, experimental flow with slower jams and unusual arrangements.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Noted for his steel‑pedal work on Dire Wolf and taking ownership of Baby Blue; overall strong guitar presence.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bobby (Bob Weir) provides vocals on Dire Wolf, adding a country‑flavored feel.
